decisions.title: Local modular application
decisions.decision: Compose a Python CLI/FastAPI application with a React dashboard and workspace-owned files.
decisions.reason: A single local workspace provides direct inspection, source retention and reproducible research without paid hosting or broker credentials in a browser.
decisions.basis: Verified implementation and authorized free/local scope
decisions.consequence: Host availability is required; no built-in remote multi-user authentication or cloud/OS startup service.

decisions.title: Reuse NautilusTrader
decisions.decision: Use a pinned external engine for strict event replay rather than recreate exchange/account primitives.
decisions.reason: A mature engine supplies fill/account mechanics while Frontier owns source timing, narrow actions, signals and qualification.
decisions.basis: Dependency and code structure; rationale inferred
decisions.consequence: Pin/version and engine identity are material; synthetic quote assumptions remain Frontier's responsibility.

decisions.title: Separate execution contracts
decisions.decision: Retain strict opening replay, next-close historical accounts, actual-minute intraday pilot, saved-model rehearsal and weekly paper baseline as distinct lanes.
decisions.reason: They use different timing, fill truth, action coverage and state persistence; one result cannot silently certify another.
decisions.basis: Verified implementations and explicit cadence mandate
decisions.consequence: Daily migration and faster reselection need separate definitions and qualification.

decisions.title: Current one-account engine construction
decisions.decision: Use the current NETTING/CASH venue account with separate USD/CAD starting balances.
decisions.reason: Native-currency cash avoids implicit FX funding and is the actual current engine configuration.
decisions.basis: Current constructor verified; older two-account notes are dated
decisions.consequence: Do not reproduce old two-account qualification as current behavior.

decisions.title: Content-addressed raw datasets
decisions.decision: Strictly validate source tables, retain originals and atomically store a content-identified manifest/Parquet bundle.
decisions.reason: Data identity and semantic rechecks prevent an edited cache or changed input from masquerading as the same experiment.
decisions.consequence: Raw adjustment/action metadata and all input identities are part of reproducibility.

decisions.title: Separate timestamp domains
decisions.decision: Keep event, availability, retrieval and ingestion clocks distinct and require event and availability <= decision.
decisions.reason: An original period/date or later downloaded file must not become an earlier public observation.
decisions.consequence: Inferred availability and revised-vintage sources remain explicit limitations.

decisions.title: Official session calendars
decisions.decision: Use exchange schedules and final partial hourly sessions; report missing observations without fill-forward.
decisions.reason: Holiday/early-close/session errors otherwise change signals, holdings and settlement chronology.
decisions.consequence: Missing required price paths remain invalid rather than retrospectively removed.

decisions.title: No implicit FX execution
decisions.decision: Use dated available FX for CAD reporting and hypothetical funding; never automatically transfer or convert funds.
decisions.reason: The owner allows planned CAD/USD funding but native settled cash and existing authorization must govern execution.
decisions.consequence: Research balances/monthly contributions are not current broker cash.

decisions.title: Refuse unsupported known actions
decisions.decision: Reject known splits in strict replay and keep the incomplete-action opt-in limited to unknown coverage.
decisions.reason: Accepting a known unimplemented transformation would manufacture holdings/value continuity.
decisions.consequence: The replay error is a real constraint; enabling unknown coverage does not correct known actions.

decisions.title: Narrow cash dividends
decisions.decision: Account for pre-ex entitlement as receivable and only convert to cash at explicit payment time.
decisions.reason: Ex-date entitlement, NAV and spendable cash are different; immediate cash permits premature reinvestment.
decisions.consequence: Gross dividends are implemented only under strict declared clocks; broader actions/tax/fractional mechanics remain unfinished.

decisions.title: Retain failures and exposed evaluation windows
decisions.decision: Save terminal failures and enforce dataset-global closed-window evaluation access.
decisions.reason: Changing campaign names or erasing inconvenient outcomes would compromise experiment interpretation.
decisions.consequence: New studies must give a reproducibility or independent-hypothesis reason, not repeat unchanged grids.

decisions.title: Typed bounded model proposals
decisions.decision: Accept restricted strategy configuration from a bounded Codex subprocess, not generated executable trading code.
decisions.reason: Typed family/parameter/known-input boundaries allow auditable proposals without arbitrary execution or silent API billing.
decisions.consequence: Authentication/version/events/attempt evidence is retained; unexpected tools/events refuse the proposal.

decisions.title: Universe and active execution are separate
decisions.decision: Broaden dated research listing capture without automatically changing the frozen eleven-stock paper universe.
decisions.reason: Exploration should be extensive while an operational policy retains stable reviewed assumptions and identities.
decisions.consequence: A listing snapshot is not historical delisted membership and a broad scan is not a broker migration.

decisions.title: Version short-hold research
decisions.decision: Implement daily 1/3/5-session accounts separately from the retained legacy 5/10/20-session grid.
decisions.reason: Every-session screening, independent positions and settled cash alter semantics beyond horizon constants.
decisions.basis: Verified versioned lane and explicit mandate
decisions.consequence: Completed short-hold failures remain visible; no unchanged rerun or paper promotion.

decisions.title: Date-specific settled cash
decisions.decision: Model historical T+3/T+2/T+1 using bank/exchange-session intersections and conservative session-open availability.
decisions.reason: Cash-only accounts cannot fund new positions with unavailable sale proceeds.
decisions.consequence: This declared convention can be more conservative than actual broker/CDS availability.

decisions.title: Fit-only preprocessing and purged partitions
decisions.decision: Fit feature/target transforms only on training, calibrate only on the calibration partition and purge labels spanning boundaries.
decisions.reason: Imputation, normalization and cross-boundary outcomes can leak future information even when model inputs look causal.
decisions.consequence: Sample floors, unavailable labels, warnings and all rejected rows remain recorded.

decisions.title: Broader fixed families, explicit head semantics
decisions.decision: Compare Ridge, ExtraTrees, boosted trees, shared-hidden multi-output MLP and declared ensemble variants.
decisions.reason: Different inductive biases test nonlinear/linear/context combinations without claiming sophistication itself supplies alpha.
decisions.basis: Implemented fixed family design and owner expansion
decisions.consequence: Six return/downside outputs do not mean transformer attention; daily-close downside does not guarantee intraday loss.

decisions.title: Calibration improvement and fallback are defined
decisions.decision: Use only calibration improvement against fitting mean for ensemble weights and preserve equal fallback.
decisions.reason: Weights must not exploit test returns; fallback makes unsuccessful/no-improvement cases explicit.
decisions.consequence: Fallback, calibration bins and forecasts are diagnostics, not qualified buy instructions.

decisions.title: Immutable trusted-local fitted artifacts
decisions.decision: Save model/preprocessing/calibration/sample/source/runtime identities and verify exact bytes before reload.
decisions.reason: Rehearsal must use the same fitted decision function and cannot silently refit or deserialize a substituted path.
decisions.consequence: Joblib is trusted-local only; a valid hash does not make malicious content safe.

decisions.title: Share scoring and cash planning
decisions.decision: Reuse daily forecast scoring and whole-share cash planning for build/rehearsal callers.
decisions.reason: Duplicated policy equations could make model previews and persistent accounts disagree despite identical forecasts.
decisions.consequence: Caller-provided reconciled positions, reserves and correlations must be correct.

decisions.title: Explicit long-only cash risk sizing
decisions.decision: Use whole shares, five-slot/20% caps and 0.5% ATR-based sizing in the new daily historical lane.
decisions.reason: Discrete affordability, limited cash and independent holds are actual account constraints rather than return-only ranking.
decisions.consequence: These are design constraints, not calibrated optimal risk or guaranteed losses; paper retains a separate four-slot policy.

decisions.title: Quantity-aware utility and frozen reservations
decisions.decision: Price entry/exit fees at candidate quantity, freeze fee-inclusive reservations and permit only quantity decreases at fill.
decisions.reason: Small-account minimum fees and fill-price changes can invalidate nominal percentage scores; fill-time replacement would introduce selection bias.
decisions.consequence: No fill-time reranking, runner-up promotion or account reset at refit boundaries.

decisions.title: Continuous saved-model state journal
decisions.decision: Chain model/policy/state identities and retain attempts in SQLite across historical replay chunks.
decisions.reason: Account state must survive restart and scheduled exits/reservations cannot disappear at chunk or fold boundaries.
decisions.consequence: Chunk size is checkpoint size; atomic research fills do not implement broker partial fills.

decisions.title: Broker fees are declared scenarios
decisions.decision: Separate proportional and verified current-tariff broker scenarios from slippage, FX, tax, subscriptions and unverified venue costs.
decisions.reason: Economic comparisons require transparent fixed assumptions; a current fee schedule is not an archived historical charge or a fill observation.
decisions.basis: Verified cost implementation and research declarations
decisions.consequence: Do not select cheaper assumptions from profitable outcomes or transfer an ETF quote allowance to stocks/options.

decisions.title: Literal paper-only endpoint
decisions.decision: Hard-code Alpaca's PAPER transport and provide no live endpoint override.
decisions.reason: Current authority is only the existing paper account; a configurable endpoint could change the meaning of execution without a reviewed migration.
decisions.basis: Verified literal host and user authorization
decisions.consequence: No live orders, options orders, funds transfer or automatic broker authentication.

decisions.title: Freeze seven operational source members
decisions.decision: Bind the initialized paper policy to normalized-text identity of its seven operational files and saved universe.
decisions.reason: Changing source under persistent orders/state can invalidate reconciliation and policy assumptions.
decisions.consequence: Code mismatch needs a separately reviewed migration; never edit and silently restart or reinitialize.

decisions.title: Broker owns fill truth
decisions.decision: Reconcile order/fill/position/cash observations before new planning or submission.
decisions.reason: Local intent, HTTP success and hypothetical simulation do not establish actual broker execution.
decisions.consequence: Unknown open orders, rejected exits, unsupported actions and unexplained cash/holdings block.

decisions.title: Persist durable ID before POST
decisions.decision: Save deterministic client ID and SUBMITTING state before sending an order; never automatically retry uncertain POST.
decisions.reason: A timeout/5xx can occur after broker acceptance, so repetition can duplicate economic exposure.
decisions.consequence: Resolve by saved ID; a missing uncertain order remains UNKNOWN rather than authorizing resubmission.

decisions.title: Reconciliation over journal replacement
decisions.decision: Retain failures, terminal acknowledgments and funding evidence instead of deleting or reinitializing the journal.
decisions.reason: Durable state is required to explain orders and cash, including uncertainty and external changes.
decisions.consequence: Resume only the initialized launcher once after process/state inspection; no duplicate cycle or blind recovery.

decisions.title: Unitized CAD sampled risk latch
decisions.decision: Track CAD risk NAV with dated available FX, adjust declared external flows and latch a sampled 30% drawdown halt.
decisions.reason: Deposits or FX reporting must not erase losses/high-water state; owner risk context is CAD.
decisions.consequence: Sampling and gaps mean no intraday hard loss guarantee; deposits/ordinary resume do not clear halt.

decisions.title: Polling is not trading cadence
decisions.decision: Keep broker watch interval separate from the weekly-entry/daily-exit paper decision clock.
decisions.reason: A five-minute health poll does not create five-minute signals or short-hold execution.
decisions.consequence: Desired daily/hourly system still needs a separately qualified migration.

decisions.title: Actual locks plus detached workers
decisions.decision: Use durable worker locks and inspect command ownership while background processes append evidence logs.
decisions.reason: Status files and stale PIDs do not establish a running owner; duplicate workers can race source/broker journals.
decisions.consequence: A returned PID means launch, not health; main historical completion does not describe another source worker.

decisions.title: Local web path and origin boundary
decisions.decision: Bind loopback, restrict hosts/origins/JSON mutations and resolve imports/artifacts inside allowed roots.
decisions.reason: Local UI operations should not become cross-site or arbitrary-filesystem access.
decisions.consequence: This is not a remotely authenticated service; public hosting requires new access design.

decisions.title: Two-output earnings adapter
decisions.decision: Reuse the shared family fitter with explicit n-by-2 targets and persist causal five-input prepared rows before outcomes.
decisions.reason: The original six-output wrappers cannot correctly represent the earnings return/downside pair; duplicating horizons would change target semantics.
decisions.basis: Implemented isolated adapter and frozen model design
decisions.consequence: All event/CIK/eligibility/prepared-row/code identities and abstentions remain part of reload.

decisions.title: Earnings source boundary and corpus completeness
decisions.decision: Use original filings/header SIC, exact original contexts and a terminal corpus binding all discovery identities and requested denominators.
decisions.reason: Current SIC, revised financial values or replacement documents can change historical eligibility and public information.
decisions.consequence: Terminal incomplete means finished with failures; never restart completed capture or refill failed issuers.

decisions.title: Earlier-release hypothesis remains undeclared
decisions.decision: Freeze a metadata-only novelty/timing definition before matching preserved original 8-K Item2.02 candidates.
decisions.reason: Earlier timestamps are an unverified explanation for weak later-filing signals, not permission to move later S/Q backward.
decisions.basis: Latest research direction; actual matching not executed
decisions.consequence: Retain every missing/duplicate/ambiguous/late candidate; verify original fiscal period/components before any separately declared earlier-time strategy.

decisions.title: Software qualification versus economic evidence
decisions.decision: Keep source/chronology/arithmetic tests, exploratory profits, prospective observations and promoted strategy states separate.
decisions.reason: Correct calculations can still describe biased sources, hypothetical costs or a losing/unqualified strategy.
decisions.basis: Explicit research mandate and retained results
decisions.consequence: No strategy is automatically promoted and no reliable weekly profit is promised.

decisions.title: Material verification without cosmetic churn
decisions.decision: Run scoped meaningful engine/account/chronology checks for changes and separately select current qualification tests.
decisions.reason: Preserved prior-version tests and reports are historical evidence, not duplicate current discovery targets; minor code churn should not displace strategy research.
decisions.basis: Repository tests/verify launcher and owner preference
decisions.consequence: This documentation inventory did not rerun tests; report latest actual checks as dated evidence.

decisions.title: Source clone and evidence package are distinct
decisions.decision: Curate project-authored isolated scripts/docs and compact evidence while inventorying local ignored data/models/journals separately.
decisions.reason: A source-only clone cannot reproduce retained market/SEC data or resume the initialized paper account.
decisions.basis: Verified ignore boundaries and publication handoff
decisions.consequence: Protect secrets/private state, preserve exact original authored paths and obtain missing trusted assets before reproduction.

production_modules.role: Date-specific historical cash settlement calendar
production_modules.docstring:
Conservative regular-way stock settlement for the daily historical study.

The trade date selects T+3, T+2 (2017-09-05), or T+1 (Canada 2024-05-27,
US 2024-05-28). We count days when BOTH banking and the local stock exchange
are open, then make proceeds available at that session's open. This is an
availability model, not a complete archive of DTC/CDS processing calendars:
CDS can settle CAD on Family Day/Civic Holiday despite closed exchanges, so
our intersection can delay cash. Broker-specific posting times are not modeled.

Primary sources, checked 2026-09-18:
- US T+2: https://www.sec.gov/rules/final/2017/34-80295.pdf
- Canadian T+2: https://lautorite.qc.ca/fileadmin/lautorite/reglementation/
  valeurs-mobilieres/24-101/2017-09-05/2017sept05-24-101-ig-vconsolidee-en.pdf
- T+1: https://www.sec.gov/exams/educationhelpguidesfaqs/t1-faq
  https://www.securities-administrators.ca/news/
  canadian-securities-regulators-announce-move-to-t1-settlement-cycle/
- Currency-specific CDS holidays: https://www.cds.ca/bulletins-and-resources/
  forms-and-documentation/holiday-processing-schedule
- No 2021 Juneteenth closure; Saturday holidays do not close Friday banks:
  https://www.dtcc.com/Globals/PDFs/2021/June/17/15471-21
- Canadian September 30 first applies in 2021:
  https://www.cdcc.ca/u_avis_en/138-21_en.pdf

This separate helper leaves the frozen, contemporary T+1 paper model unchanged.
